basic_info.description: Nestled in the vibrant Dogpatch/Central Waterfront neighborhood, this stunning penthouse offers a unique blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. With its contemporary design and prime location, Residence #18 is the epitome of chic, urban living. Step into a dramatic living space characterized by soaring ceilings with expansive windows that bathe the home with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The modern kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring Silestone quartz countertops, high-end Bosch and LG appliances. The Brizo faucets and custom cabinetry enhance the kitchen's functionality and aesthetic appeal with ample counter space and storage options. This penthouse boasts a generous-sized Primary suite, offering a private retreat with spa-like bathroom, Custom walk-in California closets and a gas fireplace. The bathrooms are elegantly designed with marble finishes, high-end fixtures, and finishes adding a touch of luxury to your daily routine. A must-see! Easy access to freeways and public transportation!
